campaigns.name: NEW Nissan Kicks e-POWER launch price 2026
campaigns.notes: Launch prices were initially tied to booking by 30 April and delivery by 31 May 2026. Headlightmag subsequently records the special-price period as extended through 30 June 2026. The normal list prices are stored separately and begin 1 July 2026.
